## 📋 General
- [ ] PR title is clear and descriptive
- [ ] PR description includes context, changes, and reasoning
- [ ] Linked to relevant issue/ticket (e.g., JIRA/GitHub)
- [ ] Appropriate labels/tags added
- [ ] PR is focused (no unrelated changes)

---

## 💻 Code Quality
- [ ] Code follows style guidelines and best practices
- [ ] No commented-out or dead code
- [ ] Proper naming conventions used
- [ ] No hardcoded secrets, credentials, or API keys
- [ ] Unused code/variables/imports removed

---

## 🧪 Testing
- [ ] Unit tests added/updated
- [ ] Integration/e2e tests added (if applicable)
- [ ] All tests passing locally and in CI/CD
- [ ] Manual testing done for critical paths
- [ ] Edge cases and failure scenarios tested

---

## 🚦 Functionality
- [ ] Feature behaves as expected
- [ ] No regression in existing functionality
- [ ] Feature flags used where needed
- [ ] Works across supported browsers/devices (if applicable)

---

## 🔒 Security & Performance
- [ ] Input validation and sanitization in place
- [ ] Proper authentication and authorization checks
- [ ] No sensitive data exposed or logged
- [ ] Performance impact considered and tested

---

## 🔄 DevOps & Rollback
- [ ] Rollback plan documented
- [ ] Feature flag in place for risky changes
- [ ] DB migration is backward compatible
- [ ] ENV/config changes documented
- [ ] Monitoring/alerting updated (if needed)

---

## 👥 Review Process
- [ ] All reviewers added
- [ ] Review comments addressed
- [ ] Merge conflicts resolved
- [ ] CI/CD pipeline is green

---

## 📎 Optional (UI/UX)
- [ ] Screenshots/video attached (for UI changes)
- [ ] Accessibility tested (if applicable)
- [ ] Localization/internationalization considered
